hook: Column ka naam pasand nahi? [[AS]] se naamkaran

slides.title: AS = [[nickname]]
points: Table mein asli naam **wahi** rehta hai

slides.title: Naamkaran [[sanskaar]]
slides.code:
SELECT
  name AS employee_name,
  salary * 12 AS yearly_salary
FROM employees;

slides.title: Result mein [[naye naam]]
slides.note: salary × 12 ka naam bina AS: kuch **ajeeb sa** aata 🤢

slides.title: Space wala [[naam]]?
slides.note: Best: space hi mat daalo, **yearly_salary** likho 👌

slides.why: WHERE, SELECT se **pehle** chalta hai. Alias tab tak **bana hi nahi** 🤷 (ORDER BY mein chalega)

caption:
Column ka naam pasand nahi? AS laga ke naamkaran karo 🏷️

Is post mein:
✅ AS se column ka naya naam
✅ salary * 12 AS yearly_salary
✅ Space wale naam ka scene
✅ WHERE mein alias kyun fail hota hai
